title: 75-5 平面与曲面组成的多面片实体 / 75-6独立叶片
current_evidence_scope: 第31项本轮调整图75–5主体外形与比例：底座加厚、板柱同宽、中央转弯加宽并对齐原图位置；绿色截面仅辅助。新A输入三格式通过；R7/R6原生候选端部精度与STEP回读未通过。推定曲率与外观仍待人工核对。

generic_oracles.quantity: support geometry + finite domains + topology class
generic_oracles.method: Compare independently sampled supports/boundaries, dimensions, placements and material-side occupancy; account for allowed face subdivision. No widening, thickening or pruning source faces.

generic_oracles.expected: exactly requested faces/edges, no silent reselection
generic_oracles.method: Resolve geometric/topological selectors after import; record candidates and expected match count; ambiguous target stops score.
Native checks plus independent seam and occupancy/orientation tests. Save raw BRep even on failure.
Evaluate shared edge and both support surfaces using actual pcurves; sample endpoints/interior and adaptive extrema.
Use consistent material/sheet orientation and evaluate normals at actual seam; end caps only exempt from G1 if declared, never from G0.

target_change: A: preserve the multi-face curved-front column/base shape and compare rolling-ball sections with disc sections driven by an explicit parameter spine.
B: test iso-parameter sections on the separately supplied blade support with a parameter spine lying on the left wall.
must_preserve: A front is two large planes plus one narrow truly curved tangent face; retain central turn and true face boundaries.
A body/slab is one connected solid; B blade sheet and its solid plate are separate examples, not one unquestioned Boolean compound.
Green section planes and dense schematic section arcs are auxiliary only; do not create many fragmented material faces to copy the drawing.
Root fillet radius is distinct from pre-existing vertical turn radius.

semantic_target.A: Three-edge concave root chain at actual slab top under the two front planes and central rounded face. Geometrically match line/arc/line after native input adaptation; no fixed Edge4/5/6 reuse.
semantic_target.B: Blade support surface + intended top support of base plate, with separate left-wall parameterization and on-wall parameter spine.

required_modes.section_plane: derived from chosen iso curves of left wall
required_modes.parameter_spine: required, must lie on left wall

diagnostic_parameters.spine_status: actual disc/iso parameter-spine curves not yet frozen; do not reconstruct them from display planes alone

feature_oracles.quantity: support face types, turn location/proportion and tangency
feature_oracles.method: Analytic dimensions and boundary/curvature sampling of two planes/central cylindrical proxy; retain source-fit uncertainty.
Evaluate actual wall normals/contact positions to reconstruct each requested section plane; test its relation to measured output cross section.

feature_oracles.quantity: section plane normal vs prescribed spine tangent
feature_oracles.method: At matched spine stations evaluate plane normal and derivative; do not substitute tangent to resulting blend spine.

feature_oracles.quantity: iso family and on-wall parameter spine
feature_oracles.expected: spine lies on left wall; selected iso family meets documented orientation rule
feature_oracles.method: Evaluate spine support-distance and UV iso geometry on the declared left wall; retain parameterization because geometric reparameterization can change this mode.
Check real side cap seams; previously valid body candidates can fail here and at STEP export.

native_paths.entry: SmApiFilletEdges / SmFilletExecutive ordinary rolling-ball root chain
native_paths.evidence: SM_API/src/SmApiBrep.cpp actual factory selects SM_FS_CONST_RADIUS / CIRCULAR
native_paths.expresses: Expresses A ordinary native rolling-ball baseline on imported/adapted topology
native_paths.boundary: Must verify full chain, terminal seams and true radius; does not implement disc or iso semantics.
A curve pointer or PointOnPlaneSolve method is not proof of a native user-supplied disc-spine/left-iso mode. An explicit port and test is required.

gaps.description: Current bridge exposes ordinary edges only; disc/iso-plane mode and parameter-spine inputs not wired or equivalence-verified.
Original exact spine, UV parameterization and hidden surface shape unavailable; freeze a controlled reproduction before scoring disc/iso.

inconsistent_if: Input is a simple box or fragmented fan instead of current curved-front multi-face body.
Only R1/R6/R7 ordinary root fillet is labelled disc or iso success.
Green helper planes/curves are presented as implemented controls.
Two end seams fail positional tolerance but result is marked fully passed.
